name: FinInteract

versions.description: Frozen evaluation snapshot used for all results reported in the paper.
versions.sanitization: No secrets, email addresses, or local filesystem paths matched the scanned patterns. The frozen scientific records are copied byte for byte without changes.

license_note: Original benchmark records are CC BY 4.0. Quoted source filings and third-party materials retain their original rights and terms. Project code is MIT licensed.
provenance: Author-constructed question, context and answer records with short evidence excerpts from SEC EDGAR filings, CNINFO/akshare filings and three DocFinQA-derived items. Raw third-party datasets and filings are not included.
intended_use: Research evaluation of ambiguity clarification and intent integration in financial question answering.
limitations: The frozen evaluation snapshot contains 173 items; the corrected public release contains 172 and should not be confused with the experimental snapshot.
Entity scope and metric definition account for 157 of 173 frozen instances. Recognition policy and temporal scope are exploratory; filing vintage has no instances.
The language split is also a source and filing-regime split: all 120 Chinese items come from CNINFO/akshare.
119 of the 120 Chinese questions mention net profit. This is not broad coverage of financial question answering.
Questions are constructed to be ambiguous. The dataset alone does not measure whether an agent knows when clarification is unnecessary.
The paired context specifies one intended interpretation; this is a controlled evaluation setting rather than observed real-user intent.
